description: This file implements a 'Library' class for dynamic library handling, including loading libraries, retrieving functions, reference counting, and unloading, with platform-specific code for Windows and Linux.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: A class for managing dynamic libraries, including loading, function retrieval, reference counting, and unloading.

methods.name: Library(const void* functionInLibrary)
methods.description: Constructs a Library object from a function pointer, attempting to load the library containing that function.

methods.name: Library(const TCHAR fileName[])
methods.description: Constructs a Library object by loading a library from a filename.

methods.name: LoadFunction(const TCHAR functionName[]) const
methods.description: Loads a function from the library by name.

methods.name: WaitUnloaded(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Waits until the library is unloaded or timeout occurs.

methods.name: AddRef()
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the library handle.

methods.name: Release()
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and unloads the library if count reaches zero.
